name: Swarm of Infesting Insects
classification: Medium Swarm of Tiny Beasts, unaligned
otherStatistics: Initiative +2 (12). Proficiency bonus +2. Blindsight 30 ft.. Passive Perception 8. No languages. No treasure.
appearance: Olive-green, segmented insect larvae with rust-red heads mingle with darker adults with translucent wings.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, Ravenloft: The Horrors Within, chapter 5, Denizens of the Mists, Swarms of Insects, digital export sheets 400–401 of 444. https://www.scribd.com/document/1054815014/Ravenloft-The-Horrors-Within-Neat-and-Tidy-Edition-1
sections.Condition immunities: Charmed, Frightened, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Prone, Restrained, Stunned
sections.Traits: Swarm. The swarm and other creatures can share a space. It can move through openings that admit a Tiny creature. It cannot regain HP or gain temporary HP.
sections.Actions: Infestation. Melee attack roll +4, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 12 (4d4 + 2) poison damage, or 7 (2d4 + 2) if the swarm is Bloodied. The target becomes Poisoned. If this poison is still active after 1 hour, the target makes a DC 11 Constitution save. A success ends the condition. On a failure, roll 1d6. On 1–2 the target becomes Blinded, on 3–4 its maximum HP drops by 5 (1d10), and on 5–6 it gains 1 Exhaustion level. The rolled effect ends when this poison ends.
sections.Encounter ecology: A hidden coffin at the Von Zarovich Sanctuary releases one infesting swarm alongside a Vampire Nosferatu. Both fight to the death.
sections.Source notes: The digital export numbers these sheets 400–401. A secondary index gives printed p. 271 for the pair. The physical folio was not available to verify. The initial attack applies Poisoned on a hit. The save takes place an hour later if that condition persists. The block gives no repeat interval.

name: Swarm of Ravenous Insects
classification: Medium Swarm of Tiny Beasts, unaligned
otherStatistics: Initiative +2 (12). Proficiency bonus +2. Tremorsense 60 ft.. Passive Perception 11. No languages. No treasure.
appearance: Olive-green, segmented insect larvae with rust-red heads mingle with darker adults with translucent wings.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, Ravenloft: The Horrors Within, chapter 5, Denizens of the Mists, Swarms of Insects, digital export sheets 400–401 of 444. https://www.scribd.com/document/1054815014/Ravenloft-The-Horrors-Within-Neat-and-Tidy-Edition-1
sections.Condition immunities: Charmed, Frightened, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Prone, Restrained, Stunned
sections.Traits:
Skeletonize. At the start of the swarm’s turn, a Large or smaller corpse sharing its space is destroyed. Anything the corpse wore or carried remains.
Swarm. The swarm and other creatures can share a space. It can move through openings that admit a Tiny creature. It cannot regain HP or gain temporary HP.
sections.Actions: Ravenous Bites. Melee attack roll +4, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 20 (4d8 + 2) piercing damage, or 11 (2d8 + 2) if the swarm is Bloodied. The insects burrow into the target and Poison it for 1 minute. A spell or effect that restores the target’s HP ends the condition early. At the start of each turn while Poisoned this way, the target takes 4 (1d8) piercing damage. It dies if this ongoing damage reduces it to 0 HP.
sections.Encounter ecology: A roll of 4 on the Trial of Hearts Jungle Events table in Valachan brings four ravenous swarms.
sections.Source notes: The digital export numbers these sheets 400–401. A secondary index gives printed p. 271 for the pair. The physical folio was not available to verify. The bite gives no saving throw. Death at 0 HP is specific to the ongoing damage. The artwork shows winged adults, but neither profile lists a fly speed.
